answer: Six strangers raise a timber frame, not one wallet. Thirty-two frames open per epoch; each locks 80 POA, +35 per extra identity: ten linked fakes lock 2,375 POA. Each joint is a walnut peg answering an echo roll-call: a stranger calls a number, the holder echoes it with the peg's hash in sixty seconds; three calls per frame. One operator raises two frames at most, so ten fakes need five hands, thirty echoes at once. A missed call burns 20; a replayed echo matches twice and both bonds burn. The chain reads the graph: frames sharing one hand collapse into one; a recording echoes too exactly.
